title: Put the cells of 147328 on the image with alignment K1
details: Deviation of the cells from the nuclei on the image (306 windows of 200 um over the tissue): median 1.0 um, 90% within 2.2 um; 1% of the windows off by 5 um or more.
No area sits off its nuclei: no local registration needed.
The cells move to where this alignment places them on the image; regions and outlines drawn before move with them.
Undo last alignment (Import dialog) takes it back.
